display_long_description:
TopologyXR is the Data Center Digital Twin creation tool.
In TopologyXR anybody can start creating a Digital Twin within their environment without prior knowledge within minutes. You can design and manage your data center in your environment, simply scan your environment and bring it to VR and place some racks, deploy the servers, and Network them with different cable connections. 
TopologyXR has powerful MR creation capabilities that especially shine on Meta Quest Pro. You can create a data center in your environment in real-time while being in your environment, and visualize how your data center will look before it is constructed.
TopologyXR allows data center owners, managers, and planners to visualize data centers in their environment, find potential loopholes, and present them to different stakeholders easily by creating a digital twin of data centers made with the TopologyXR app.
